title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics quicklinks + SLO toolkit helpers
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: On recent incidents the oncall path to the most-relevant runbook/docs has been too manual. This PR adds first-class quicklinks in incident-bot oncall messages and exposes a small set of SLO toolkit helpers so runbook linking can be computed and surfaced reliably. The change reduces mean time-to-context for responders by surfacing candidate runbooks, relevant SLOs, and playbook links directly in the incident thread.

What this PR does (summary):
- incident-bot: add quicklinks API and plumbing to attach compact runbook links and SLO references to oncall messages.
- slo-toolkit: add runbook_helpers.lookup_candidate_runbooks and format_quicklink helpers used by the bot and by alerting rules.
- UI: small quicklinks widget for the incident view that renders prioritized runbooks + rationale.
- Docs: update oncall runbooks guide and incident-bot playbook to mention quicklinks and opt-out config.
- Tests: unit + integration tests that exercise lookup heuristics and CI workflow to exercise e2e fixture.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add quicklinks API and telemetry hooks (incident-bot/server/quicklinks.py)
- [x] Expose SLO-toolkit helpers and unit tests (slo-toolkit/runbook_helpers.py)
- [x] Add UI widget and snapshot tests (incident-bot/ui/quicklinks_widget.tsx)
- [x] Update playbook/docs (docs/oncall/runbooks.md)
- [x] Add CI e2e job and flaky tolerance for external catalog lookups (infra/workflows/ci.yaml)

Compatibility and rollout:
- Default behavior is opt-in via organization config flag incident_bot.enable_quicklinks. For hosted customers the flag is off by default for first rollout window. For internal Redwood org we enabled behind a feature flag for dogfood.
- Quicklinks are cached per-incident for 10 minutes to avoid repeated catalog calls; cache sizes and TTL are configurable.
- Telemetry: added metric incident_bot.quicklinks.generated (counter) and slo_toolkit.runbook_candidates.count (histogram).

Testing and QA:
- Unit tests for candidate selection heuristics (matching by SLO name, alert fingerprint, and title keywords).
- Integration test that runs incident-bot with sample incident payloads and asserts quicklinks appear in messages and UI widget.
- CI e2e run initially flaky due to external doc-catalog mocks; added a retry and deterministic fixtures.

Notes / follow-ups:
- Follow-up to ENG-2412 will add confidence scoring and auto-rank based on historical click-through and incident resolution correlation.
- Consider extending runbook metadata schema to include "preferred_oncall_role" to better match runbooks to incident owner.

Related: ENG-2412, ENG-2478, SUP-5321.

Merge strategy: squash and merge after approvals and green CI.
